# happy’s

> happy’s is a cocktail bar and event space in downtown Cary, North Carolina, at 126 W Chatham St #200 (ground floor, the black door). House cocktails, draft beer, jello shots, hot dogs and personal pizza, live music every Saturday night, a patio, and private event bookings. Walk-ins only, no reservations, 21+.

## Basics
- Address: 126 W Chatham St #200, 1st floor, Cary, NC 27511
- Phone: (919) 378-9009
- Email: thewalkupcary@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/happyscary/
- Hours: Thu–Fri 4pm–12am, Sat 1pm–12am, Sun 1pm–11pm, Mon–Wed closed
- Price: about $10–20 per person
- Policies: 21+ only, walk-ins only, no reservations

## What it’s known for
- House cocktails around $10–12: happy’s margarita, spicy margarita, orange crush, espresso martini shots, painkiller, mojito
- $5.50 drafts and $18 pitchers, $5 shots, jello shots (1 for $2, 3 for $5)
- Bar food: personal pizza, grilled cheese, pub tenders, hot dogs (1 for $3, 2 for $5), pimento cheese, charcuterie
- Zero-proof cocktails and NA beer
- Live music every Saturday, 7–10pm, local acts
- The smiley-sticker wall, TVs for games, patio seating
- Private events: birthdays, work nights, parties
